modules.summary: The application foundation and entry point. Sets up the Express server with middleware, configures the application from environment variables, establishes error handling, and launches the server on startup.

A complete notes feature module. Defines the data model, validates user input, stores notes in memory with CRUD operations, and exposes REST API routes for clients to create, read, update, and delete notes.

project.name: express-notes
project.purpose: A REST API service built with Express.js and TypeScript that manages a collection of notes. The server provides endpoints for clients to create, read, update, and delete notes, storing them in memory with validation.
project.architecture: The application begins at src/server.ts, which starts the Express server. The server runs the app configured in src/app.ts, which sets up middleware, error handling, and routes. At the foundation level, three modules establish the core infrastructure: src/config.ts reads environment variables, src/errors.ts defines error handling, and src/notes/note.ts defines the note data model. The notes storage layer (src/notes/notes.store.ts) uses the note model to manage in-memory CRUD operations, while src/notes/notes.validation.ts validates incoming note data. The notes routes (src/notes/notes.routes.ts) connect HTTP requests to storage operations through validation.
keyConcepts: REST API design and HTTP routing
Separation of concerns in layered architecture
